verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Lorikeet exposing itself AS an MCP server that other AI clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex) connect to — the reverse of this story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers INTO Lorikeet so it can consume their tools. As an agentic product, acting as an MCP client is a natural and applicable capability, but no evidence shows Lorikeet importing or calling external MCP servers.
